newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen higher at open.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen higher at open.

text.p: The $13 billion merger deal between McDonnell Douglas Corp and Boeing Co is expected to help push Wall Street stocks higher at the open on Monday.

Both stocks were quoted sharply higher ahead of the open, with McDonnell Douglas traded at 64 on the Instinet system, up from a close of 52 on Friday, while Boeing traded at 105, up from its Friday close of 96-3/4.
In addition to the merger news, high tech stocks, which have taken a beaten recently, were set to open higher after posting overnight gains in London.
